description: Source code for FreeType library's glyph handling functions, including support for bitmap and outline glyphs, glyph creation, copying, transformation, bounding box calculation, and conversion to bitmap.

classes.name: FT_BitmapGlyph
classes.description: Glyph class for bitmap glyphs, supporting initialization, copying, bounding box calculation, and cleanup.

classes.name: FT_OutlineGlyph
classes.description: Glyph class for outline glyphs, supporting initialization, copying, transformation, bounding box calculation, and preparation.

methods.name: ft_bitmap_glyph_init
methods.description: Initializes a bitmap glyph from a glyph slot.

methods.name: ft_bitmap_glyph_done
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a bitmap glyph.

methods.name: ft_bitmap_glyph_bbox
methods.description: Calculates the bounding box of a bitmap glyph.

methods.name: ft_outline_glyph_init
methods.description: Initializes an outline glyph from a glyph slot.

methods.name: ft_outline_glyph_done
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an outline glyph.

methods.name: ft_outline_glyph_transform
methods.description: Transforms an outline glyph with a matrix and translation.

methods.name: ft_outline_glyph_bbox
methods.description: Calculates the bounding box of an outline glyph.

methods.name: ft_outline_glyph_prepare
methods.description: Prepares an outline glyph for rendering.

methods.name: ft_new_glyph
methods.description: Creates a new glyph object based on class.
